hypothesis: Correcting last-substep vertical-velocity reward aliasing may reduce transferred right-wheel unloading; it is not established as a sufficient explanation of the contact mismatch.
scientific_change_from_trial004: wheel_vertical_velocity_sampling: last_substep -> all_substeps_mean; description metadata updated
activation_prerequisite: Actual Isaac runtime smoke verifies all four refreshed physical substeps, bit-exact quadratic rewards, reset isolation, observer chaining, unchanged dimensions and successful sampler/environment teardown; owned process exit independently confirmed.

training.domain_randomization: motor-v1, unchanged episode-fixed shaft friction, speed and torque capacity randomization
training.checkpoint_selection: Predesignated model_final.pt after all 600 updates; no best-of-rollout selection or extra updates based on evaluation.

unchanged.wheel_actions: Normalized direct motor torque with unchanged torque-speed curve and shaft resistance; no car steering or torque copied as robot action targets.

evaluation.conditions: Nominal motors, fixed seed42, source reference frame0 and its initial velocity; same exported actor including its learned normalizer.
evaluation.recording: Actual 200 Hz first-episode physical states/contact patches in both engines plus original 50 Hz policy archive; no second-episode states or hidden root writes.
evaluation.assessor: scripts/assess_drift.py, unchanged behavior and reference-progress thresholds
evaluation.source_fidelity_diagnostic: Separately corroborate qualifying drift's overlap with source sideslip windows and matching sign, using the same read-only diagnostic as trial004; these are not implemented as assessor gates.
evaluation.primary_gate: At least 0.20 s contiguous speed>=0.4 m/s, forward component positive, abs(sideslip)>=8 degrees, both actual bearing wheel-ground contacts and measured mean lateral patch slip>=0.04 m/s.
evaluation.other_gates: All existing source fidelity, tracking, two-wheel support, no nonwheel impact, full 5.76 s episode and stable-exit checks must also pass; gaps are not bridged.
evaluation.diagnostic_comparison: Trial004 versus trial005 actual right-wheel unloading count/duration, clearance excursion and full-substep squared vertical velocity; reward improvement alone is not transfer success.
evaluation.format: Captured car -> TRON1 kinematic reference -> Isaac policy -> MuJoCo same policy; full recorded four-panel video and contact timeline, including failure.

resources.mode: One authorized remote RTX4090D app at a time; fresh target idle/UUID guard and unmasked native PhysX/Torch/tensor device audit.
resources.diagnostic_only_change: Optional read-only runtime device audit adds no actions, observations, physics steps or control changes.
resources.cross_gpu_contexts: All owned GPU context rows are recorded privately; non-target contexts are not claimed absent or harmless.
resources.other_users_jobs: Never terminated or altered. Resource placement is recorded separately from scientific settings.
